repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhshTXCAmv9KJXRZkB ## 席位核对 · L1 (seat 3, L1-a) · 2026-11-17T05:01Z L1: REWORK Head-sha: 48d70e286426b0e0c0b7793f6e0b9e32ac60d15d Card: #34361 (ruling A 6917968848, plan 6936836041) · claim 6937110802 · os-dev-report 6938509737 · execution note 6938618374 The code, tests and the Clause-② widening all hold. The one must-fix is paper only, the same kind as #34624's: one changed file is outside the claim's file surface. No push is needed. Once the seat posts the claim amendment, I post ACCEPT on this same head. ### Must-fix (paper only, no code change) 1. **`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.approvalDeclaredActions.test.tsx` (an existing test, +24/−1) is outside the claim's file surface.** Claim 6937110802 covers `RecordDetailView.tsx` "(call site only)" and "new tests beside them". This is an edit to an existing test file, declared as deviation (2) in the os-dev report. The edit itself is right; see the readings. The seat posts a claim amendment adding the file, and the PR body names it in one line. ### Should-fix None. ### Readings that hold | Item | Reading | |:--|:--| | PR shape | Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34361`; no other closing verb in the body (`#25877`, `#26053`, `#34631`, `#34588` stand verb-free). No `!`, no `(narrowing)`: no dogfood battery owed. | | Scope | 19 files; 18 inside the claim surface (`DeclaredActionsBar.tsx`, `utils/approvalDecisionFold.ts` (+ test), `RecordDetailView.tsx` (+8/−1: a comment and the `foldDecisions` prop, call site only), `ApprovalDecisionPanel.tsx` (+3: a comment and the prop, call site only), the new `__tests__/DeclaredActionsBar.approverFold-34361.test.tsx`, 11 locale files, the changeset). `RecordApprovalsPanel.tsx`, though listed in the claim, is untouched (consistent with keeping reply in the menu). | | Clause-② (TIER_DEFAULT, seat routing) | Body and changeset match the claim: `yes (widening — new @object-ui/i18n en keys only …)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. The published face moves only in `@object-ui/i18n`: four add-only keys under `approvalsInbox` (`awaitingYourDecision`, `stepNumber`, `submittedByName`, `moreDecisionActions`), +4 lines in each of the 10 non-en packs and +7 in en (the 4 keys plus a 3-line comment). Nothing is renamed or removed. `foldDecisions` is a new optional prop on `DeclaredActionsBar`, which is exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`; that package is `"private": true`, so this is not a published accept set. No spec/schema or governed-rule face is touched, so no further L2 is owed. | | Changeset | Names `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`. Sentences read against the diff:
• "folded for any viewer the server says can act (`viewer.can_act === true`) once more than two … shown" = `isActingApprover` (strict `=== true`) plus `foldDecisionOthers = … (!everyLeverReported \|\| drawnNames.length > 2)`.
• "status line names the task, the step's number … its label, and the submitter ('You submitted this' …)" = `ApproverTaskStatus`: the badge, `currentStepNumber(flow_route.steps)`, `step_label`, then `viewer.is_submitter` → `submittedByYou`, else `submitter_name`.
• "`variant` `primary` or `danger` stay buttons; phone equal width" = `isLeadDecision` plus `fill` (`flex-1 sm:flex-none`).
• "every other action, including one declared with no variant, goes into one neutral menu" = `decisionOthers` into the `DropdownMenu` with an outline trigger and no amber.
• "same band on both pages" = the prop at both call sites.
• "keeps its own gates … same request" = the same `DeclaredActionButton` (`asMenuItem` in the menu).
• "Menu actions still count as drawn" = `DeclaredActionVisibilityProbe` reporting into `reportDrawn`.
• "Unchanged: submitter-only, override-only admin, no `viewer` block, hosts without the prop" = the `decisionBand` guard (`foldDecisions && folded.length === 0 && isActingApprover`).
All true. `@object-ui/console` (the shipping package) is not named; its `src/**` did not move, so it is not required. | | Ruling A fidelity | Status line with the step (number and label) and the submitter: met. 通过 / 拒绝 as the only buttons: met, read off `variant`, not names (plan 6936836041 §1). Other levers in one menu, neutral trigger: met. Record header untouched: met (no header hunk). No protocol change: met. 撤回 (recall) for an approver who also submits sits in the menu: inside A's latitude ("left to execution"). | | `reportDrawn` change | It now records `false` verdicts as keys so `everyLeverReported` can be read. `drawnNames` still filters on `drawnByName[name] === true`, so the drawn list is unchanged, and `foldOverrides` reads the same set. The fold-until-all-reported default means a lever that never reports leaves the band folded, which is the safe side. | | Existing-test edit (the must-fix file) | The three approver pins still assert that reassign / send back / request info are offered and that `approval_send_back` dispatches on the REQUEST. They now open the band's menu first and assert `role="menuitem"`, so the edit adds assertions without loosening any. Submitter, override and fail-closed cases are untouched. | | Docs | `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` describes the gates (`can_act` / `is_submitter` / `can_override`) and the actions, not their placement; nothing there is made false. There is no `content/docs/frontend` page for the bar (declared). | | Tests | Real commands with output: the closure was built, then 115 files / 2059 tests passed on the head. There are 12 + 7 new pins. One ablation (`isLeadDecision → true`) turns the 6 split-dependent pins red while the 6 controls stay green, and the file was restored to the HEAD blob. | | Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34641`: NOT governed, 0 of 19 paths, 826 lines. Tier S, lands through o3-A. | | CI on this head | 62 check-runs: all `success` or `skipped`. Test UI 16/16 shards plus the aggregate, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are all `success`. | ### Notes 1. **Reply (`approval_comment`) stays in the menu, against ruling A's "approvals panel or discussion".** The seat accepted the deviation and recorded it on the card (6938618374). The reasons hold: the bar cannot know whether the panel is on screen, and the panel has no action runtime. Because it departs from the ruling's wording, I'd suggest the seat put it on the maintainer's pending-decision list (with the usual independent review first) rather than leaving it to be discovered. This is not an L1 bar. 2. **Hot file with #34631** (`ApprovalDecisionPanel.tsx`): the seat's ruling stands. Whichever lands second re-adds the one `foldDecisions` prop, and the second one owes a delta read on that line. 3. Not measured in a real browser: the phone row (two `flex-1` decisions plus the trigger) and the desktop line wrapping with long step labels. The landing area may glance at 390 px if it boots the console.
